style.toneOfVoice: An easy to style, impactful focal point. The Oversized Christmas Conifer Swag injects a healthy dose of the holidays into your home. Featuring handsomely lush conifer foliage that’s scattered with 80 warm white LEDs, this swag has been designed to be oversized to create visual impact. Its classic swag design is shaped at its fullest in the centre, and beautifully tapers towards the ends. At over 2m long, there’s plenty of length and volume to create impressive indoor or outdoor displays – think mantelpieces and window frames. To illuminate, simply insert 3 x AA batteries into the attached battery box and switch to ‘on.’ Select the optional 6-hour timer for an automatic glow at the same time each evening. With an IP44 rating, this swag is suitable for use outdoors.
